svg.text: Every Sunday: get live YouTube videos → measure and group them → AI writes the brief → save it and email it → Ishaan plans the right video
Side job: a daily wake-up call
A quick check every morning keeps the free database awake (it sleeps after 7 idle days)
reads his niche + today's saved data
one channel can't fake a trend
the settings page shows it back
same day + same niche = no refetch
last good copy if a run fails
How to read it: follow the numbers 1 to 15 left to right. The circled A is the optional manual button; dashed arrows show what gets passed on.
Built with: Vercel (hosting + timer) · Supabase (database) · Gemini Flash (AI) · YouTube Data API (videos) · Resend (email) · all free plans
Safety: every input and AI answer is checked · the last good brief is kept if a run fails · 369 automatic tests · tested on every code change · 70-point check on the live site
